name: Weaviate
tagline: Weaviate is an open-source vector database that enables semantic search, hybrid search, and generative AI queries over large datasets. It supports text, image, and multimodal embeddings, and provides built-in integrations with OpenAI, Cohere, and Hugging Face for vectorization.
